source.title: Potential-energy surfaces for the doubly even N = Z nuclei

direct_original_fields.claim: Dimensionless xi_i=sqrt((m*omega0/hbar)*b_i)*x_i; b_x=1-2epsilon/3*cos(gamma+2pi/3), b_y=1-2epsilon/3*cos(gamma-2pi/3), b_z=1-2epsilon/3*cos(gamma). omega0 here has no circle mark.

General spinor angular ME with primed bra lprime,jprime,Omegaprime equals the printed double-bar element times CG; no explicit 1/sqrt(2jprime+1) in A2. A3 gives angular Ylambda reduced coefficient with half-spin CG and parity projector.
Unmarked omega0 divided by upper-circle omega0 is fixed by volume conservation; determinant stretch factor multiplies angular D^(-3/2) integral including gamma and epsilon4.

direct_original_fields.locator: PDF20/printed112 paragraph before A8 and A8/A9/A10
direct_original_fields.claim: Explicitly neglects gamma degree of freedom; q2nu=<nu|sqrt(16pi/5)*r^2*Y20|nu> and q4nu=<nu|r^4*Y40|nu>, all same-nu expectation values, not nuprime-nu transition formulas. rho^2=xi^2+eta^2+zeta^2; nu is an MO eigenstate.

direct_original_fields.locator: PDF6/printed98 Eqs10–12; PDF7/printed99 Table1 header and footnote
direct_original_fields.claim: Q0 is a total proton Q-like sum. Q40 includes Z^(-1) and no Q0 harmonic scaling. Printed table units are fm^2 and fm^4, with theory micr./macr./HF and experimental B(E2), electron- and alpha-scattering columns. Historical table has hbar*omega0_circle=41 A^(-1/3) MeV; not a Ce parameter.

task_derived_bridges.claim: Identify omega_i=omega0*b_i for b_i>0, giving the dimensionless coordinate already defined by 042; dimensionful X_i=ell0*xi_i.
With matched CG phases and standard 3j WE of 041, R_standard=sqrt(2*jprime+1)*r_LL75; this conversion is task-derived from A2.
For p=1+epsilon/3,s=1-2epsilon/3, pointwise O20=ell0^2/(p*s)*[(2*zeta^2-xi^2-eta^2)+(2epsilon/3)*rho^2], yielding A8 and the 042 axial limit.

Taking general bra/ket of the pointwise axial identity is mathematically allowed in one fixed coordinate/basis convention, but A8 itself prints only diagonal nu and is not labelled an offdiagonal publication formula.
